title: The Fermi Paradox: Why 300 Million Worlds Are Dead Silent
description:
The Fermi Paradox asks a terrifying question: if there are 300 million habitable worlds in our galaxy, why has space remained dead silent?

NASA's Kepler data suggests our Milky Way is teeming with rocky planets, yet sixty years of SETI searches have returned zero confirmed signals. From the "Great Filter" theory to the rare "Microbial Stall," we explore the brutal evolutionary bottlenecks that might explain why we haven't heard from anyone else yet.

🔔 Subscribe for daily strange science: https://www.youtube.com/@proofofwonderscience?sub_confirmation=1

▶️ Watch more Proof of Wonder Shorts: https://www.youtube.com/@proofofwonderscience/shorts

Do you think the Great Filter is behind us (we got lucky), or is it still waiting in our future?
